svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.16.5.1 Wood-Frame Floors
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.16 FLOORS-ON-GROUND
to CSA S406, "Specification of permanent wood
foundations for housing and small buildings"
Drawn: a generic wood floor on a granular layer beside a wood foundation wall. The construction itself is set out in CSA S406. Layout and sizes are illustration only.
